_about: Every real-world number shown to players comes from this file. 'verified' means the value was read in the listed source on the 'checked' date. Game-scaled values live in src/sim/config.ts and are explained on the Sources page.

sol_length.label: Length of one sol (a Mars day)
sol_length.source_title: NASA GISS — Technical Notes on Mars Solar Time as Adopted by the Mars24 Sunclock

light_delay_min.label: Shortest one-way radio delay, Mars to Earth
light_delay_min.source_title: NASA — Space Communications: 7 Things You Need to Know
light_delay_min.note: At closest approach, about 35 million miles.

light_delay_max.label: Longest one-way radio delay, Mars to Earth
light_delay_max.source_title: NASA — Space Communications: 7 Things You Need to Know
light_delay_max.note: At greatest distance, about 250 million miles.

mars_surface_dose_eq.label: Radiation on the Mars surface (Curiosity RAD)
mars_surface_dose_eq.source_title: Hassler et al. 2014, Science 343, 1244797 — Mars' Surface Radiation Environment Measured with MSL's Curiosity Rover
mars_surface_dose_eq.confirm_title: Zeitlin, Hassler et al. 2014 — New Results from the MSL-RAD Experiment on Curiosity (8th Int. Conf. on Mars, abstract 1151)
mars_surface_dose_eq.note: Measured Aug 2012 – Jun 2013. The Science paper is paywalled; the value was read in the RAD team's open conference abstract.

mars_surface_absorbed.label: Absorbed dose rate on the Mars surface (Curiosity RAD)
mars_surface_absorbed.confirm_title: Zeitlin, Hassler et al. 2014 — New Results from the MSL-RAD Experiment (plot shows 180–240 µGy/day over the first 300 sols)

cruise_dose_eq.label: Radiation inside the spacecraft on the trip to Mars (Curiosity RAD)
cruise_dose_eq.source_title: Zeitlin et al. 2013, Science 340, 1080 — Measurements of Energetic Particle Radiation in Transit to Mars on the Mars Science Laboratory
cruise_dose_eq.confirm_title: Zeitlin, Hassler et al. 2014 — New Results from the MSL-RAD Experiment on Curiosity

iss_absorbed.label: Absorbed dose rate inside the Space Station (Columbus module)
iss_absorbed.source_title: NASA OSDR RadLab — DosTel1 and DosTel2 readings, ISS Columbus, 1–7 April 2022
iss_absorbed.note: Computed for this project: time-weighted mean of 16,699 readings (DosTel2 10.69 µGy/h = 256 µGy/day; DosTel1 12.18 µGy/h = 292 µGy/day). One quiet week; the rate changes with altitude and the solar cycle.

career_limit.label: NASA career radiation limit for astronauts
career_limit.source_title: NASA OCHMO Technical Brief: Radiation Protection (NASA-STD-3001)
career_limit.note: "Total career effective radiation dose due to space flight radiation exposure shall be less than 600 mSv."

opportunity_last_contact.label: Opportunity rover's last message to Earth
opportunity_last_contact.source_title: NASA — NASA's Record-Setting Opportunity Rover Mission on Mars Comes to End

opportunity_end.label: Opportunity mission declared complete
opportunity_end.source_title: NASA — NASA's Record-Setting Opportunity Rover Mission on Mars Comes to End
opportunity_end.note: More than 1,000 recovery commands were sent. The rover was designed for 90 sols and drove more than 45 km.

opportunity_design_sols.label: Opportunity's planned mission length
opportunity_design_sols.source_title: NASA — NASA's Record-Setting Opportunity Rover Mission on Mars Comes to End

dust_2018_tau.label: Sky dustiness (tau) over Opportunity on June 10, 2018
dust_2018_tau.source_title: NASA JPL — Opportunity Hunkers Down During Dust Storm
dust_2018_tau.note: The 2007 storm Opportunity survived had a tau somewhere above 5.5.

dust_2018_area.label: Area covered by the 2018 dust storm on June 12, 2018
dust_2018_area.source_title: NASA JPL — Opportunity Hunkers Down During Dust Storm

sep2017_mars.label: September 2017 solar storm at Mars
sep2017_mars.unit: surface radiation vs. any earlier RAD reading
sep2017_mars.source_title: SwRI / NASA — Large Solar Storm Sparks Global Aurora, Doubles Radiation Levels on the Martian Surface
sep2017_mars.note: Solar event of Sept 11, 2017. High readings lasted more than two days. MAVEN saw an aurora more than 25 times brighter than any it had seen before.

may2024_mars_dose.label: May 20, 2024 solar storm dose next to Curiosity
may2024_mars_dose.source_title: NASA — NASA Watches Mars Light Up During Epic Solar Storm
may2024_mars_dose.note: Flare later estimated at X12. "Equivalent to 30 chest X-rays" and the biggest surge RAD had measured since landing.

may2024_xrays.label: May 20, 2024 storm dose compared with chest X-rays
may2024_xrays.source_title: NASA — NASA Watches Mars Light Up During Epic Solar Storm

round_trip_cruise.label: Radiation for the shortest round trip to Mars (travel only)

mars_sunset_blue.label: Color of the sky around the Sun at sunset on Mars
mars_sunset_blue.note: Fine dust lets blue light through more easily, so blue stays close to the Sun's part of the sky. Photographed by Curiosity on sol 956 (April 15, 2015).
mars_sunset_blue.source_title: NASA Science — Sunset in Mars' Gale Crater

bone.study_title: Targeting myostatin/activin A protects against skeletal muscle and bone loss during spaceflight
bone.source_title: NASA Open Science Data Repository, OSD-342

muscle.study_title: Effects of 21 days of bedrest on human skeletal muscle gene expression
muscle.source_title: NASA Open Science Data Repository, OSD-195

sleep.study_title: Comprehensive multi-omics analysis reveals mitochondrial stress as a central biological hub for spaceflight impact
sleep.source_title: NASA Open Science Data Repository, OSD-343

radiation.study_title: Transcriptome Profiles in Normal Human Bronchial Epithelial Cells after Exposure to gamma-rays and different HZE particles
radiation.source_title: NASA Open Science Data Repository, OSD-73

food.study_title: Toolkit for educators and youth – Food production on the Moon and in remote areas
